metadata.description: The administrator user name.
The administrator password. The password must be between 14 and 72 characters and have 4 of the following: 1 lower case character, 1 upper case character, 1 number, and 1 special character.
The name of the lab host virtual machine resource name. This value is not used for the virtual machine's computer name.

By specifying True, will be deploy Azure Bastion Developer.
The tools to be installed on the lab host virtual machine. Use ';' to separate tool's symbol. Supported tool's symbols are windowsterminal, vscode.
By specifying True, will be auto-shutdown configured to the lab host virtual machine.
